scope_drift.snippet: One of the owners of our Auto Repair shop used to work for a Doctor's office where they used DF for all of their scheduling needs. She loved it so much that when they opened their Auto Repair business she implemented it into their shop.  Since I have been working with it (over the past 6 years) it's had some ups and downs. I use it mainly for marketing and I have really liked it for that purpose. It's easy, allows me to add my own art, design my own email blasts and is pretty intuitive. There are definitely some tweaks that need to be made but overall, it's pretty good. As for scheduling, it serves its purpose. I'm not sure if our issues are because we don't know how to use it properly or if it's just not the best setup for an Auto Repair shop.  Anytime I have had an issue, DF is quick to connect me with a service rep. My current rep has been absolutely fantastic. He's extremely responsive and has conducted 1 on 1 training sessions in every area I've inquired about.  I had issues in the past with reps responding in a timely manner, but for now that seems to be worked out. The reason for the 3 stars is that there are some seemingly simple requests I've made for changes to our online scheduling portal and the marketing options, but I don't have any confidence these changes will ever be granted. Also, after all of these years, we still need additional software to make our shop scheduling and customer communications run smoothly. If DF had it all, we wouldn't need more. If I could, I would rate it 3.5 stars; settled on 3 because 4 is too much.
